description_en: You can call the DescribeNodesInstanceType operation to query the types of data plane nodes and determine whether MultiBuffer performance acceleration is supported
description_zh: 调用DescribeNodesInstanceType查询数据面节点类型，判断是否支持MultiBuffer性能加速
name: DescribeNodesInstanceType

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ASM instance
parameters.name: service_mesh_id

InstanceTypes.description_en: A list of node type information

Key.description_en: The key of the node label that supports MultiBuffer optimization. If you specify this parameter, MultiBuffer optimization is enabled only when a pod is scheduled to a node that has this label key and a label value that matches the \`Value\` parameter
Key.description_zh: 支持MultiBuffer优化的节点标签key（如果填写了该值，则只会在pod调度到带有该标签，且标签值等于`value`时启用MultiBuffer优化）

MultiBufferEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the MultiBuffer acceleration feature is supported. Valid values:

`true`: The MultiBuffer acceleration feature is supported.

`false`: The MultiBuffer acceleration feature is not supported
MultiBufferEnabled.description_zh:
是否支持MultiBuffer加速功能，取值：

`true`：支持MultiBuffer加速功能

`false`：不支持MultiBuffer加速功能

NodeType.description_en: The instance type of the node

Value.description_en: The value of the node label that supports MultiBuffer optimization. If you specify this parameter, MultiBuffer optimization is enabled only when a pod is scheduled to a node that has the specified \`Key\` and a label value that matches this parameter
Value.description_zh: 支持MultiBuffer优化的节点标签的值（如果填写了该值，则只会在pod调度到带有该标签，且标签值等于`value`时启用MultiBuffer优化）
